label: Fill needed for a target
subgoals: Multiply the window area by the minimum density
Subtract the existing metal to get the deficit
Divide by one fill square's area and round up

label: Legal fill sites
subgoals: Grow every metal shape by the fill spacing
Test each candidate square against the grown metal
Count the candidates that stay clear

label: The best reachable density
subgoals: Compute the existing metal inside the window
Add the area of every legal fill site
Divide by the window area and compare with the target
